Global options such as `--base-url`, `--tenant` and `--json` go before the command — see [CLI reference](./index.mdx#global-options). Exit codes are listed in [Exit codes](./exit-codes.md).

## apiome export {#export}

Export a version to a target format via the emitter registry. Registered targets are also invokable as ``export <format> <artifact>`` (async job + poll). ``export evidence --json`` returns the machine-readable projection evidence (snapshot hash, status/reason counts, per-construct rows). A lossy/types-only export exits non-zero without --force, and a job whose acknowledged preview snapshot no longer matches fails with STALE_PREVIEW — re-preview and acknowledge the current snapshot.

```text
apiome export [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`asyncapi`](#export-asyncapi), [`avro`](#export-avro), [`deliver`](#export-deliver), [`deliveries`](#export-deliveries), [`evidence`](#export-evidence), [`graphql`](#export-graphql), [`grpc`](#export-grpc), [`openapi`](#export-openapi), [`preflight`](#export-preflight), [`presets`](#export-presets), [`profiles`](#export-profiles), [`targets`](#export-targets).

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--preset` | text |  |  | Run a saved export preset (name or id): apiome export --preset NAME ARTIFACT --out PATH [--version V \| --items …] [--deliver PROFILE]. Manage presets with 'apiome export presets'. |

## apiome export asyncapi {#export-asyncapi}

Export a version as AsyncAPI 3 + a fidelity report. With --output -, document bytes are written to stdout; the fidelity summary and --json metadata are written to stderr so stdout stays byte-safe for pipelines.

```text
apiome export asyncapi [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--project` | text |  | yes | Project UUID or slug. |
| `--version` | text |  | yes | Version UUID, slug, or label. |
| `--output`, `-o` | text |  | yes | Destination file path, or - for stdout (document bytes only). |
| `--tenant` | text |  |  | Tenant UUID or slug (overrides APIOME_TENANT_ID). |
| `--yaml` | flag |  |  | Request YAML serialization (default JSON). Alias for --accept yaml. |
| `--accept` | text |  |  | Response serialization: json or yaml (default json). |
| `--force` | flag |  |  | Write and exit 0 even when the export loses fidelity (lossy/types-only). |
| `--min-grade` | text |  |  | Fail when the lint grade is worse than this (A best, F worst). Exits 4 when the threshold is missed. |
| `--fail-on` | text |  |  | Fail when the lint report has any finding at or above this severity (error, warning, info). Exits 4 when the threshold is missed. |

| `--limit` | integer range |  |  | Maximum evidence rows per page (server clamps to its hard cap). |
| `--redact-source` | flag |  |  | Deprecated no-op (EFP-3.2): REST always redacts source-native evidence. |
| `--tenant` | text |  |  | Tenant UUID or slug (overrides APIOME_TENANT_ID). |

## apiome export preflight {#export-preflight}

Rank every export target for one revision — source lint, projected fidelity, capability fit, and the tenant quality-policy verdict. Nothing is emitted and no export job is created. Gate exit codes: 3 = tenant quality policy blocked, 4 = --min-grade/--fail-on threshold missed, 5 = nothing gradable (candidate unimportable / no usable target). These are distinct from transport (1) and usage/auth (2) failures.

```text
apiome export preflight [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--project` | text |  | yes | Project (artifact) UUID or slug to rank targets for. |
| `--version` | text |  |  | Revision UUID, slug, or version label (default: latest revision). |
| `--to` | text (repeatable) |  |  | Restrict the ranking to this target key (`openapi`) or format key (`openapi-3.1`). Repeatable; omit to rank every registered target. |
| `--tenant` | text |  |  | Tenant UUID or slug (overrides APIOME_TENANT_ID). |
| `--min-grade` | text |  |  | Fail when the lint grade is worse than this (A best, F worst). Exits 4 when the threshold is missed. |
| `--fail-on` | text |  |  | Fail when the lint report has any finding at or above this severity (error, warning, info). Exits 4 when the threshold is missed. |

## apiome export presets {#export-presets}

List, create, change and delete the workspace's export presets (targets, options, delivery). Run one with: apiome export --preset NAME ARTIFACT --out PATH.

```text
apiome export presets [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`create`](#export-presets-create), [`delete`](#export-presets-delete), [`list`](#export-presets-list), [`show`](#export-presets-show), [`update`](#export-presets-update).

## apiome export presets create {#export-presets-create}

Create an export preset: apiome export presets create nightly-sync --target openapi --option openapi:openapi_version=3.0 --target protobuf --deliver data-lake.

```text
apiome export presets create [OPTIONS] NAME
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `NAME` | text | yes | A name unique in the workspace. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--target` | text (repeatable) |  | yes | A target format (repeatable, in order): one is a single-target export, several a multi-target one. |
| `--option` | text (repeatable) |  |  | TARGET:KEY=VALUE — an emit option for one of the targets (repeatable; VALUE parsed as JSON when valid). |
| `--deliver` | text |  |  | A delivery profile (name or id) the export is delivered with on completion. |
| `--description` | text |  |  | What the preset is for. |

## apiome export presets update {#export-presets-update}

Change a preset's name, description, targets (replaced whole by --target / --option) or delivery (--deliver PROFILE, or --no-deliver to remove it).

```text
apiome export presets update [OPTIONS] PRESET
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PRESET` | text | yes | Preset name or id. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--name` | text |  |  | A new name. |
| `--description` | text |  |  | A new description ('' clears it). |
| `--target` | text (repeatable) |  |  | Replace the targets (repeatable, in order). |
| `--option` | text (repeatable) |  |  | TARGET:KEY=VALUE — an emit option for one of the targets (repeatable; VALUE parsed as JSON when valid). |
| `--deliver` | text |  |  | A delivery profile (name or id) the export is delivered with on completion. |
| `--no-deliver` | flag |  |  | Remove the preset's delivery profile. |

## apiome export profiles create {#export-profiles-create}

Create a delivery profile. git: --repository [--path --base-branch --mode]. webhook: --url --secret-env VAR [--artifact]. object_storage: --credential --bucket [--prefix --partitioning].

```text
apiome export profiles create [OPTIONS] NAME
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `NAME` | text | yes | A name unique in the workspace. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--channel` | text |  | yes | git, webhook or object_storage. |
| `--description` | text |  |  | What the profile is for. |
| `--repository` | text |  |  | git: the registered repository id. |
| `--path` | text |  |  | git: the directory the bundle is written under. |
| `--base-branch` | text |  |  | git: the base branch (default: the repository's default). |
| `--mode` | text |  |  | git: pr (default) or commit. |
| `--url` | text |  |  | webhook: the receiver URL. |
| `--secret-env` | text |  |  | webhook: the environment variable holding the signing secret. |
| `--artifact` | text |  |  | webhook: auto (default) or fetch. |
| `--credential` | text |  |  | object_storage: the storage credential id. |
| `--bucket` | text |  |  | object_storage: the bucket. |
| `--prefix` | text |  |  | object_storage: the key prefix. |
| `--partitioning` | text |  |  | object_storage: artifact,version,target in order ('' for none). |
